notes.title: Soul Axiom Steam Sale & 1.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MYBAf6s.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]SALE! SALE!![/h1]
Great news everyone... To coincide with today’s update, we’re putting Soul Axiom on sale with [b]40% off![/b] That also includes the Artbook & Soundtrack DLC, Deluxe and Super Deluxe Edition!
 
The sale won't be around for long so grab it now for almost half price and support the game by spreading the word!
 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/279900/

Since the launch of the game on Steam we’ve had the opportunity to attend the PC Gamer Weekender and more recently we were at EGX Rezzed where Microsoft demo’d the game on the Xbox stand! It was another great opportunity to show off and talk about the development of the game through Steam Early Access :-)
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZuyEIcKl.jpg[/img]

Now, for those patch notes…
 
[*] NOTE: This update will be live for Windows, Mac and Linux. 
 
[h1]Access to Corrupt Portals - Puzzle Saves[/h1]
[*] This update brings a more efficient way of revisiting levels and finding the Corrupt portals. Now, when a player has received the Corrupt Power, they will no longer have to redo puzzles in each level to find the portal. Many puzzles will be now be completed and locked entrances will be open. In some levels, this will also make it quicker to find missing PEMOs.
 
[h1]Improved Mechanics [/h1]
[*]  We’ve now increased the speed of the Phase, Play, Destroy and Corrupt hand powers which will give more precision, more noticeably when targeting smaller or moving objects.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/5xY8lRn.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Optimisation[/h1]
[*] Major optimisation pass across entire game to increase general FPS and reduce spots with FPS drops.
 
 
[h1]Minor Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements[/h1]
[*] Fixed a rare issue when the game would crash selecting a mirror in the Waiting Room.
[*] Fixed an on-going issue with the statues sometimes not accepting the right order in Church.
[*] Fixed some minor occlusion issues in various areas.
[*] Fixed some minor snagging issues.
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/NzVXtYt.jpg[/img]
 
Thank you all once again for your Soul Axiom support and you can continue to help support the game by leaving your thoughts in the review section! ːsoulsharkː
 
Wales Interactive Team

[h1]Soul Axiom Launch[/h1]
Hi everyone! We hope you’ve all enjoyed the 1.0 version of the game and we’d like to thank you all once again for your awesome contribution during the Early Access development. Since the launch, we’ve taken the game to the PC Gamer Weekender (where we had a fantastic response from gamers) and we’ll also be featured at EGX REZZED in just a couple of weeks’ time in London. If you’re attending the show, feel free to hunt us out and say hi!

 [*] This update will be going live for Windows, Mac and Linux.  

[h1]Optimisation[/h1]
[*] Major optimisation pass across entire game to increase general FPS and reduce spots with FPS drops. 

[h1]Linux Graphical Issue [/h1]
[*] While we are continuing to resolve the graphical issues on Linux builds, we have implemented a temporary fix. The problem is the 'Bloom' feature we use in-game creating large white graphical effects with certain Linux drivers. Linux users now have the option to turn off the Bloom effect in the settings. We would just like to thank you all for your patience on this issue and we will continue to find a solution to the underlying problem. 

[h1]Minor Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements[/h1]

notes.title: Update – 1.0 Release Date & Blue Duck Fun
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lrvR5QJ.jpg[/img]

[h1]Official 1.0 Release Date[/h1]
Hi all, now we’re nearing the end of Early Access development, we’re releasing the last few updates with minor bug fixes and improvements. We now have an official release date of 29 February 2016.. A Leap Day!! 
We are still to plan one more update before the release so Early Access contributors still have time to join in the with finishing touches of the game. Gamers will also notice a dramatic reduction in file size originally from around 12GB to a much lower size of just under 5GB. This is mainly down to a major ‘behind the scenes’ optimisation pass. 

[h1]Operating System[/h1]
This update will be going live with Windows, Mac and Linux. We had reports of a major visual bug in the previous Linux build so please get in touch via the forums if those problems are still occurring. 

[h1]Achievement Fixes[/h1]

[h1]Minor Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements[/h1]
* Fixed an issue causing the player not to achieve the Corrupt Power if leaving the Forest after unlocking the platform

notes.title: Chapter Six Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Here's a quick update on how the development is going...

As you might be aware this next update has taken a lot longer than expected. The reason being we were forced to update the game engine because of a bug which made it impossible for us to continue developing on. Unfortunately, the engine update broke a lot of animations and materials in the process so we've been working hard on fixing those. Also, we've completely overhauled each level with our biggest optimisation pass throughout the game and so you should see a significant increase in FPS.

As well as FPS improvements, you'll also find huge changes to the lighting in many levels plus extra animations, gameplay tweaks and story hints throughtout the game. Not forgetting you'll also have the final installment to get stuck in to.

The content will be coming your way next week so keep an eye out for the next announcement. 

Thank you all for sticking with us and we hope you're looking forward to the next update. We're so close to the end now and we can't wait to bring a content complete game to you all. 

Cheers! 

Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: Unity 5 Update, Gamescom, Story Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/NHnMS3f.jpg[/img]

Greetings to the Soul Axiom Steam community!!

First of all we’d like to thank you all for your support on the forums which have played such an important role in the development of Soul Axiom. We appreciate you sticking around and writing your suggestions and we hope you continue with us until the end. 

Last month we posted an announcement stating we’re upgrading the game engine from Unity 4 to Unity 5. If you haven’t seen that, you can click [url=steamcommunity.com/games/279900/announcements/detail/231154170446479104]this[/url] link. Updating the engine has required us to completely overhaul every level and steps have been made to improve a number of aspects of the game which would have caused problems with the old engine. Because of this it has taken us a little longer than expected but it just means the final game will be a much improved version. 

We are now happy to announce we’re very close to the end and have planned to release the new content next week. 

We will make a detailed announcement of all the cool new features as well as bug fixes and general game upgrades when the update is complete but expect the main improvements on the surface of the game to be within the lighting, shaders, audio and general frame rate. Note that your hand powers will now illuminate areas that are intended to be dark. On top of this we’ll also be releasing the much awaited final levels of Chapter Four!

Here’s a few screenshots to show off some of the progress in the earlier levels…

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VJJb1s2.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RrjS5OA.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pJyUbb1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gamescom 2015 & New Trailer[/h1]

It’s finally confirmed we’ll be taking Soul Axiom to Gamescom Cologne 2015! More top secret news will be coming soon with regards to this event so keep your eyes open for that as well as a brand new trailer. The trailer will feature a lot of unseen footage so you won’t want to miss it. Be warned… it’s cool, really cool!

Thank you all again for your patience with this update and we hope you’re all looking forward to completing Chapter Four!

Don’t forget if you want to support the game then you can leave a Steam review on the store page or share the game with your friends. Feel free to share any of our updates on our [url=www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive]Facebook[/url] and [url=www.twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter[/url] also. 

If you have any questions just get involved on the forum or get in touch at support[at]walesinteractive[dot]com.

Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: New Update – Chapter Four, The Apartment & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oVM7AYt.jpg[/img]

[h1]Chapter Four is here! [/h1]
We’ve certainly been busy here at the WI studio with both the release of Infinity Runner on consoles and the Chapter Four update of Soul Axiom! We want to thank you all for your patience with this upcoming Chapter and we hope you’re excited for even more updates coming soon. 

[h1]Please Read [/h1]
Before you read on, we’d like to ask for your help. We’re looking for as much feedback on the levels as possible so please read the announcement at the end of the post if you’d like to support the development of the game. 

[h1]So… What's New?[/h1]
 [*] This update brings you a brand new level and the start of Chapter Four! It’s moving in day and you’ve received your keys to your very own apartment! Haul in your new furniture, get out your paint buckets and unbox your… time machine. That’s right, your brand new state-of-the-art time machine. 

[*] Travel through time as you create a paradox that will test your brainpower to its limits. Explore the hidden passages and written messages in every time zone to figure out what's really going on in the apartment.

[*] We’ve not only added 4 brand new PEMO’s but we’ve also hidden a surprise which, if you’re lucky enough to come across, may prove useful later in the game. 

[*] The final memory of Chapter Three has been added. Complete the Ice Palace to unlock your memory in the Hub!

[*] An update to the Elysian Fields contains a new animated event on the cliffs as well as updated visuals to the corrupt character.

[h1]Additional Changes/Bug Fixes[/h1]

-	Major bug fixed in the Beach level which stopped you from getting one of the cubes.  
-	Updated controls system – Smoother and supports more controllers. 
-	Added a difficulty curve to the sword puzzle in Ice Palace.
-	Fixed an issue with the glass container reflecting the sky in War Zone.  
-	Major Fog Volume issues are now fixed. 
-	Improved textures and lighting in War Zone. 
-	Improvements to set pieces in War Zone. 
-	Change of power for the hidden walls in Mansion.
-	Optimised the Ice Palace.
-	Fixed some reflection maps in University. 
-	Fixed an issue with SFX on the Zodiac puzzle in Ice Palace.
-	Fixed a lot of collision issues in Ice Palace.
-	SFX added to Ice Palace
-	Delayed the pyramid falling in the Desert Temple level.  
-	Increased the size of some hit markers in the Jungle and Beach level. 
-	Changed placement of the Eye in the Mansion level. 
-	Fixed some snagging issues on the platforms in the Hub.
-	General improvements to models and textures throughout game. 

 [img]http://i.imgur.com/05ScZH3.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Feedback Thread[/h1]
We appreciate all the feedback given so far and now, as we’ve started Chapter Four, we want to hear as much feedback as possible. Not just bug reports but feedback on the general flow of the game, what you found too easy or hard, what you think works well or not etc. Any comments are welcome and you can also support the game by leaving a thumbs up on the Store Page!

Please leave all your feedback from either individual levels or the game as a whole [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/279900/discussions/0/34096318710945818/]here[/url].

We hope you enjoy the latest instalment of Soul Axiom!

Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: New Update – The Mansion, University Tweaks & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/U4TF9d8.png[/img]

The full moon is shining! This update brings you a brand new level, The Mansion! Pull out your silver bullets and grab your Wolfsbane… something terrible hunts. The Lycan stalks the walls of the mansion.  

[code][h1][i]Then their fun turns to feast
A piece for each, a fight for the heart
With flashing teeth and snarling growls
And then the head impaled on a spike of stone 
Above the door of the reeking den
A warning to those still living 
Not to cross the werewolves' path[/i][/h1][/code]

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[*] Aaoooooo! A new level is here! Project the waning moon to unlock your path ahead, discover the past inhabitants of the mansion and gather your alchemy books to brew the perfect potion!

[*] Get lost in the creepy halls and scare off the beast that stalks you!

[*] 4 brand new PEMO’s scattered around the Mansion. Find them all to reveal the haunting clues to this memory. 

[*] The University level has been updated! Check it out to find an improved flow, better hints, clearer hit markers, enhanced SFX and an updated brain puzzle!

[h1]Additional bug fixes[/h1]

-	New graphic to show you objects you can interact with but can’t use at that moment in time. This will usually be because you haven’t got the necessary object such as a key or because that object isn’t unlocked yet. 
-	Optimisation pass on various levels including the Museum and front end menu. 
-	Balanced SFX throughout game, including the teleport spheres. 
-	Animation improvements in War Zone.
-	Fixed an issue where the interact hand will appear after interacting with a ladder.
-	Fixed an issue where the water wouldn’t rise after death in University. 
-	Smoother animation transitions from opening scene in University. 
-	NOTE: We will be adding another puzzle to this level in the next update. 

[h1]New Feedback Thread[/h1]
We appreciate all the feedback given so far and now, as we come closer to the end of Chapter Three, we want to receive as much feedback as possible. Not just on bugs but feedback on the general flow of the game, what you found too easy or hard, what you think works well or not etc. 

Usually, after new content is released we will patch up any bugs about a week later including making tweaks to the flow of the game so feel free to re-visit an older update as things may have changed. 

Please leave all your feedback from the University, Mansion and other levels [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/279900/discussions/0/34096318710945818/]here[/url].

Thank you all for your support and we hope you're looking forward to the final installment of Chapter Three, coming soon!

Wales Interactive Team

Chapter Three is here! It’s finally time to start rolling out Chapter Three and what better way to kick things off than with the Hospital. [*] Doctor, doctor! We have a new level! Smash open the cold chambers, escape the chilling atmosphere in the morgue, reveal the coloured shades of grief in the chapel, solve x-ray puzzles and discover the secrets within the hospital corridors. 

[*] PHASE… PLAY… DESTROY! Use all three powers to solve the puzzles and unlock the secrets to your memory. Get to grips with the destroy power, we’re sure you’ll find them a hoot in this level…

[*] 4 brand new PEMO’s scattered around the environment. Find them all to discover why death surrounds you in the eerie halls of the Hospital.

notes.title: Update - The War Zone, Destroy Power & More
notes.notes:

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

Our latest update is our biggest yet! Containing not only our final level of Chapter Two but more rooms to explore and a brand new POWER! We took a little longer with this update to fit in as much new content and bug fixes as possible. So, what's all the fuss about? Here we go...

[*] Hoorah! We have our fourth and final level of Chapter Two, The Warzone. Explore the memory alongside tanks, helicopters, AI bots and more! 

[*] A brand new soundtrack for the front end menu. A trip down memory lane for this one...

[*] The HUB has had a make-over and now features the Trophy Room and the Memory Capsules. The Trophy Room is there for you to keep track of your PEMO's, this will be updated soon so you know exactly what PEMO's you have collected and which level you need to re-visit to find the clues to your story. The Memory Capsules are a collection of your memories that you unlock at the end of each level.  

[*] We've now introduced a brand new power! The Destroy power! We have implemented some changes to the previous levels for this power but the real fun will come in Chapter Three which will be available soon. 

[*] We have been working hard on creating general improvements to the flow to the game and with that, comes a brand new save system. Please Note: Because of this new system, any progress after the HUB level will have been lost which means players will have to re-visit these levels. This was a decision we had to make to create a better gaming experience for all future levels and ideas we will be bringing to the game. A lot has been added to the game over the past couple of weeks so this will give you a chance to see what's new in the world of Elysia. 

[*] You may or may not have noticed there are a few strange and mysterious items that can be found in the game. All will be revealed in future levels of the game. Have you found what we are talking about?

notes.title: The day is here, SOUL AXIOM early access version has arrived!
notes.notes:
The day is here, SOUL AXIOM early access version has arrived! 

Originally we planned for the early access version of the game to feature [b]Chapter One[/b] of the adventure only, with [u]5 locations to explore[/u]. We are pleased to say that we've also squeezed in some of [b]Chapter Two[/b] content for you to demo as well containing a new player ability to supplement the new game mechanic introduced in Chapter One. 

These levels are fully playable and will introduce you to the new game mechanics/abilities but there are areas of these levels that we are still working on to add that extra polish. The game won't be totally bug-free either and if you're experiencing an issue or have suggestions for improvements then your feedback is vital to help us fix it. 

The PC version has been continuously tested and should be the most robust version. As well as PC we have included Mac & Linux support although these platforms have not been fully tested so you may encounter more problems with these builds.

We want to make Soul Axiom the best it can be and being able to have feedback from the community whilst we are developing the title will be invaluable to us. This really is your chance to influence the end product and play a part in the game design process.

In the next few weeks we will be releasing the complete version of Chapter Two, implementing achievements as well as addressing any issues encountered or improvements requested by the community. 

Thank you for supporting the game and welcome to the team!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/279900

Wales Interactive Team
